description: Reacher connects ChatGPT to your TikTok Shop affiliate program. Ask about GMV, creators, videos, samples and campaigns in plain language and get answers from your live Reacher data instead of a dashboard. Find creators across the open TikTok market, see who is actually driving sales, review sample requests and automations, and pull the numbers behind a weekly report — for one shop or all of them. Write actions such as creating an automation or replying to a creator are labelled and confirmed before they run, and money movement is not available through ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: Which of my TikTok Shops is driving the most GMV this month?
Who are my top performing creators over the last 30 days?
What outreach automations are running right now?
